description: ABSTRACT-CLAIM EXPANSION: replicate-and-extend wording anywhere in title plus abstract, together with a reference to an original/previous/prior/earlier/published/seminal/classic study, finding, result, experiment, paper, effect or research. The prior-study phrase allows up to two intervening words. This brings the measured additional abstract-level claims into the two-voter screen without promoting all eight broad replication-claim-text arms. The original study may be named only by the screen/extractor; co-occurrence is a screening signal, not a semantic or completion verdict. Precedence 738: below replication-claim-title-broad (740) and curated-observatory (745), retaining their attribution; above replication-claim-cited-abstract (737), replication-claim-failure-prior (736) and replication-claim-general (735), so prior-study replicate-and-extend claims receive the highest attribution of the three new measured pools. Like the general rule it yields to the structural discards (935-960) and outranks the fallible not-a-study-type crosswalk (500). Repository DOI and replication-package/materials/data/code title exclusions are copied verbatim from the live general rule. The rule requires an abstract, names no vocabulary and only schedules screening. Measured over the f4225e6 live-bundle baseline; analysis/admission_rules_2026_10/README.md records the frozen population, marginal order, uncertainty and model labels.

measured.sample: analysis/admission_rules_2026_10/screened_cases.csv, rule=replication-claim-extend-prior; 80 previously reviewed marginal works plus 60 uniformly sampled fresh works (seed 20261007) from the remaining marginal pool, read blind from title and abstract; see populations.csv and manifest.json.
measured.rationale: 2267 additional available works after preceding new rules, excluding existing live screening admissions, FLoRA doi_r, exported and validated-skip works. Fresh pilot: 43/60 clear with source-matched quotes and no obvious title/abstract mismatch. Previously reviewed members: 52/80 clear under the same policy. Precision field is a population-weighted estimate of model-judged actionable yield (0.714), not independently validated truth or the production two-voter proceed rate. Conditional fresh-sample Wilson interval, weighted with the observed previous members: 0.594-0.809; no bound on model-label error. Admission only; no automatic acceptance/discard and no screen-generation change.
